#### Proposal 1: The Claude Harness Nexus · psyche-belief › vision/claude-harness-nexus/0.md

::: comment
The notion harness-nexus 0 holds, beyond the Harness Nexus vision, the whole of the Claude Harness Nexus: its hook and its transcript, each turned into the events every Harness Nexus tells. It becomes a vision module of its own, as the Codex one is; he named the Claude Harness Nexus among the components of version 1. Changed on the way: the type that holds a session's id is SessionId, by Naming.1; the two JSON examples go, since he said of a third party's message «the schema is really what interests us», and the Ethos beside them is that schema. One contradiction for him to settle: this notion reads the transcript for what the hooks do not carry, the context's size, an interruption and a compaction, while he called watching the transcript «the absolute last resort». It is kept here as that last resort, for those three things alone.
:::

::: description
+ The Claude Harness Nexus, the Harness Nexus of Claude Code: its hook and its transcript.
:::
